messages.subject: OUF models during bird nesting
parts:
Hi there,

I'm new to movement data and trying to get on top of what I need to do with some of my PhD data. I have GPS tag data from a number of breeding birds, so there is a combination of foraging trips and static signals when the bird is on a nest. Is an OUF model appropriate here as I understand it combines correlated velocities and restricted space use. Or have I misunderstood something? I'm trying to calculate home range estimates in order to consider habitat usage during nesting season. 

Many thanks in advance for any advice!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: OUF models during bird nesting
parts:
Hi Elli,

The models in ctmm are currently stationary, so you would want to segment the data into foraging and nesting.
With the foraging data, you would then run model selection, which the vignettes and workshop scripts will steer you through. If the data support it, the OUF model will come out as the selected model.
Then you can move on to home-range estimation and habitat selection.

Best,
Chris
